messages:
Maya Patel: Heads up — opened docs PR #7893 for console observability snippet updates (dashboard cost widget + tracing hook example). Found a couple broken links and an old tracehook example referencing the v1 header. Can reviewers please sanity-check the snippets? cc @Samir Chen @Eli Vargas
Samir Chen: On it. Which links are broken? I can sweep the sidebar and samples folder.
Maya Patel: The guide-to-traces link on the dashboard page 404s (old handbook path), and the embed sample references `sdk/old-trace` which we removed. Also the Python snippet uses `attach_trace(context)` which is v1-only.
Eli Vargas: I can rewrite the Python & Node snippets to use the new `TraceContext` helper. Quick draft:
```python
from redwood import TraceContext
ctx = TraceContext.start()
resp = client.generate("summarize", prompt, trace_context=ctx)
```
Need to include a short note about the sampling default.
Jun Park: Also noticed the console CSP blocks iframe embed for the live sample — we should add a `sandbox` recommendation or provide a static screenshot fallback. Filed ENG-3142 for the CSP tweak.
deploy-bot: CI: docs-lint passed for branch docs/snippet-update (PR #7893) :white_check_mark:
Samir Chen: :thumbsup: I'll do the link redirects and update the handbook path to /docs/traces/overview. PR checklist: update snippet paths, add redirect, leave comment calling out ENG change.
Maya Patel: Thanks. Could someone add a one-sentence migration note at the top: "If you're migrating from tracehook v1, replace `attach_trace` with `TraceContext` and pass it to client calls."
Eli Vargas: Added migration note in the PR description. Also included a tiny cost/latency breakdown example that shows `tokens * price_per_token` and a 3-line table. Want me to inline the sample or link to the deeper notebook?
Samir Chen: Inline the short example + link to the notebook for details. Keep the snippet <= 10 lines.
Maya Patel: Also need runtime reviewers for technical accuracy — tagging @Jun Park and @Samir Chen. Can someone ping product for wording? Ping Lena Ortiz in #product, please.
Jun Park: Will ping Lena. Also we should bump the SDK example versions: Node `@redwood/sdk@^2.1.0` and Python `redwood-sdk>=2.1.0`.
Samir Chen: Done. Also fixed two anchor links. Preview: https://deploy-preview-7893--docs.redwood.com/console/observability#cost-breakdown
Maya Patel: Preview looks good visually. Two small nits: 1) change table header "cost-per-token" to "unit token cost". 2) add alt text to the embed screenshot.
Eli Vargas: :rocket: Will patch those now.
Samir Chen: Ready for final review. Assignees: Maya Patel (docs), Jun Park (runtime review), Lena Ortiz (product copy).
Maya Patel: Merging after final thumbs. If anyone sees regressions after the merge, open an issue with the `docs/snippet-regression` tag and reference PR #7893.
Samir Chen: Merged — small follow-up PR incoming for the CSP fallback screenshot.
